content:
- It's probably too much for a clash
- I will also do the reverse problem

Additional things I could do:
-Add seconds or miliseconds (optionally)
-More stuff for the frame.
-Show both a watch and the alarm, and the calculate how much time you still got to sleep
-Bigger Numbers and add the Date (including date of the week?)
-More stuff similar to particular watches and their operation

If you look at it there is already a scanner problem, which is quite similar to what I am using:
https://www.codingame.com/training/easy/7-segment-scanner
While this 7-segent writer is quite different:
https://www.codingame.com/ide/puzzle/7-segment-display

I also got some inspiration from this contest:
https://codegolf.stackexchange.com/questions/19196/transform-number-into-7-segment-display-pattern

You're probably right about this being too much for a clash, see a previous contribution that got deactivated for poor ratings: https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/7842478e1e3d0729ed0770b8aa8b38663090

See also a similar clash (but for the reversed task): https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/996425a084ff058dad270a487a40f39011f04

Well, let's see, either I could upgrade it to easy, as is.
Or I might make it a little bit more complicated watch.
